maya_sec: Vendor kickoff in 48h. Need quick decisions: freeze RBAC changes, evidence immutability, and KMS rotation behavior.

pt-bot: kickoff Thu 09:00 PT - assessment ~48h.

evan_infra: I can set a repo precommit gate to reject IAM grants during the window and create s3://pt-evidence/181112/ with Object Lock COMPLIANCE.

zack_sre: +1. Also snapshot runtime KV-cache and request traces (-6h..+6h) and include SHA256 manifest.

clare_prod: app teams will not accept vendor PUTs to buckets. Provide presigned GETs only and whitelist vendor IP range 198.51.100.0/24.

maya_sec: KMS: prefer pausing automatic rotation for alias/ri-pt-181112 during the window. Evan, can you scope impacts? If pause risky, we'll record key version per object in manifest.

evan_infra: will check. If pause ok, resume at window end +10m. Posting command snippets and bucket policy in the runbook PR.

zack_sre: fast-track retest criteria draft: Low=config fix (retest 48h), Medium=code/canary (72h), High=architecture -> formal schedule.

maya_sec: owners: security=intake & verify, infra=keys & bucket, SRE=runtime fixes, app=product fixes. I'll open tracker entry and tag people.

evan_infra: posted object-lock create command and presigned GET example in PR.

pt-bot: reminder: tabletop dry-run Wed 16:00 PT.
